key_sections.headline: Zero-Cloud Session Transfer for Chrome.
key_sections.subheadline: Move authenticated state — Cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB & Cache Storage — seamlessly between profiles or devices. AES-GCM encrypted, 100% local, ephemeral keys, zero servers.
key_sections.badge: Manifest V3 Compliant • AES-256-GCM • No Telemetry

key_sections.title: How Session Transfer Works in 3 Steps

steps.title: Export Session on Source Browser
steps.desc: Select storage drivers (Cookies, LocalStorage, IndexedDB) for target origin. Extension packages state into an in-memory bundle.

steps.title: Encrypt & Generate Ephemeral Code
steps.desc: Client-side AES-GCM encryption with Argon2/PBKDF2 key derivation. Generates a 6-digit transfer code + optional encrypted payload file.

steps.title: Import & Verify on Target Browser
steps.desc: Enter transfer code or import payload on Browser B. State is verified, injected into origin storage, and page reloads authenticated.

key_sections.title: Interactive Local Session Transfer Simulator
key_sections.description: Test the export, AES-GCM encryption, ephemeral key generator, and import restoration pipeline right inside this interactive sandbox.
features: Simulated Source Browser (Browser A) with active session cookies and storage items
Real-time AES-256-GCM encryption preview showing encrypted ciphertext and salt
Ephemeral 6-digit transfer code generator & download package trigger
Target Browser (Browser B) session restorer with verification status logs

features.name: 5 Storage Types Covered
features.desc: Cookies (HttpOnly supported via Extension APIs), localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache Storage.

features.name: AES-256-GCM Encryption
features.desc: Authenticated encryption with ephemeral keys derived in Web Crypto API. Zero plaintext exposure.

features.name: Serverless & Air-Gapped
features.desc: No external cloud API, no tracking server, no backend database. Peer-to-peer payload transfer.

features.name: Origin Isolation
features.desc: Exported sessions are strictly bound to original domain origins to prevent cross-site session leaking.

features.name: Honest Security Limits
features.desc: Transparent disclosure: WebAuthn, hardware passkeys, and TLS channel bindings cannot and should not be exported.

features.name: Audit Log & Expiry
features.desc: Exported packages expire automatically after 5 minutes or upon single-use import.

key_sections.title: Supported Storage vs Non-Transferable State Matrix
rows: Injected to current active tab origin

key_sections.title: Quick Packaged Extension Installation
instructions: Download session-transfer-v1.2.0.zip using the CTA above.
Unzip the package on your local computer.
Open Chrome and navigate to chrome://extensions.
Enable 'Developer mode' toggle in the top-right corner.
Click 'Load unpacked' and select the unzipped directory.
Pin Session Transfer to your Chrome toolbar and start transferring sessions securely.

faqs.q: Is any session data sent to a remote server?
faqs.a: No. Session Transfer runs 100% locally in your browser context. All encryption occurs using Web Crypto API inside your browser process.

faqs.q: How do I transfer sessions between separate devices?
faqs.a: You can copy the encrypted payload file via direct local transfer (AirDrop, USB, local network share) or use the 6-digit ephemeral transfer code.

faqs.q: Does this work with HttpOnly cookies?
faqs.a: Yes, because the Chrome Extension Manifest V3 cookies permission grants authorized access to HttpOnly cookies for targeted domains.
WebAuthn keys are securely isolated inside hardware TPMs or OS Secure Enclaves by browser design standards and cannot be extracted.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page responsive React app (.js / .jsx) with a high-impact dark technical aesthetic.
Ensure header navigation is fixed with backdrop blur, brand logo, section anchors, and a prominent Download CTA.

Implement the full Interactive Session Transfer Simulator component where users can toggle active session keys, click 'Export & Encrypt', view encrypted AES payload outputs, generate a 6-digit transfer code, and test the 'Import & Restore Session' pipeline with visual success logs.
Include a simulated Chrome Extension installation drawer or modal with step-by-step visual guidance.
Include direct download action for the packed extension zip (triggering mock download of session-transfer-v1.2.0.zip file with metadata).
Ensure all interactive elements have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-cta-download', data-testid='sim-export-btn', data-testid='sim-import-code-input', etc.).
Never use pure black background; use rich deep slate/obsidian (#080B11, #0F1523). Accent with emerald green (#10B981) for trust and cyan (#06B6D4) for data flow.
Use JetBrains Mono for technical headings, code snippet blocks, and transfer codes.
